# Architecture Decision Records

| ID | Title | Status | Date | Summary |
|---:|-------|--------|------|---------|
| [0001](0001-use-a-local-ollama-vision-model.md) | Use a local Ollama vision model rather than a hosted description API | Accepted | 2026-08-19 | Descriptions come from a vision model served by Ollama, because the workload is high-volume and includes images commercial services refuse. |
| [0002](0002-use-stdlib-urllib-as-the-transport.md) | Use stdlib urllib as the transport instead of the ollama client library | Accepted | 2026-08-19 | The library's three JSON POSTs are written against urllib.request, keeping Pillow the only runtime dependency and letting the tests drive a real HTTP server. |
| [0003](0003-image-in-string-out-failures-are-exceptions.md) | Image in, string out, every failure an exception | Accepted | 2026-08-19 | describe() returns a plain str and raises on every failure, under one hierarchy rooted at DescribeItError, with TypeError kept for a wrong-type argument. |
| [0004](0004-default-to-qwen35-4b.md) | Default to the qwen3.5:4b vision model | Accepted | 2026-08-19 | The packaged default model is qwen3.5:4b, chosen for refusal resistance over caption quality, and overridable with $DESCRIBE_IT_MODEL. |
| [0005](0005-prepare-images-as-rgb-jpeg-over-white.md) | Prepare every image as an RGB JPEG flattened onto white | Accepted | 2026-08-19 | Any PIL mode is normalised in one pure function — alpha flattened onto white, LANCZOS downscale, JPEG quality 90 — and the caller's image is never mutated. |
| [0006](0006-clean-replies-to-a-fixed-point.md) | Clean the model's reply to a fixed point | Accepted | 2026-08-19 | A reply is stripped of think blocks, labels, quotes and markdown until stripping stops changing it, and an empty result is a DescriptionError. |
| [0007](0007-fix-the-sampling-options-for-a-caption.md) | Fix the sampling options for a caption call | Accepted | 2026-08-19 | Every chat request carries temperature 0.2 and num_predict = max_words * 4 + 32, the latter a safety stop rather than the length control. |
| [0008](0008-build-a-private-urllib-opener.md) | Build a private urllib opener that ignores proxies and does not follow redirects | Accepted | 2026-08-20 | Each client builds its own OpenerDirector with an empty ProxyHandler and no redirect handler, because both urllib defaults are wrong for a service on localhost. |
| [0009](0009-never-pull-a-model-implicitly.md) | Never pull a model implicitly | Accepted | 2026-08-19 | A describe call against a missing model raises ModelNotFoundError naming the ollama pull command; downloading happens only in an explicit ensure_model() call. |
| [0010](0010-gate-on-a-hermetic-suite-and-keep-live-tests-opt-in.md) | Gate CI on a hermetic suite at 100% coverage, with live tests opt-in | Accepted | 2026-08-19 | The merge gate is a hermetic unit suite at 100% line and branch coverage; tests against a real model are opt-in, non-blocking, and assert structure only. |
| [0011](0011-send-think-false-unconditionally.md) | Send think:false unconditionally, without a capability probe | Accepted | 2026-08-20 | Every chat request carries think:false, because Ollama 0.32 accepts it from models that cannot think and the specified fallback probe would cost a round trip per description. |
| [0012](0012-normalise-a-host-the-way-ollamas-cli-does.md) | Normalise a host the way Ollama's own CLI does | Accepted | 2026-08-20 | A scheme-less host gets http:// and port 11434 as Ollama's OLLAMA_HOST parsing does, while a host written with a scheme is used exactly as written. |
| [0013](0013-guard-the-refusal-heuristic.md) | Detect refusals with a guarded heuristic rather than letting them through | Accepted | 2026-08-19 | A refusal phrase opening a short or run-on reply raises DescriptionRefusedError, which carries the cleaned text; the guard keeps descriptions that merely start "I cannot see". |
| [0014](0014-validate-configuration-at-construction.md) | Validate configuration where it is written, not at the first request | Accepted | 2026-08-20 | An unusable host, timeout, model tag or word budget raises at construction rather than surfacing later as an unrelated-looking connection error. |
